updates.status_evidence: “Career Catalyst Research (CCR)” appears as a current grant mechanism on Komen's Scientific Research Grants page.
updates.notes_append: Resolved 2026-09-17 with a rendering browser (komen.org returns HTTP 403 to a text fetch). Komen cautions that “the scientific focus areas of our grant mechanisms can vary from year to year”, so the mechanism exists but its topic scope is cycle-dependent. Note the row's sibling link komen.org/.../grants/current-funding-opportunities/ is a 404; the live path is /breast-cancer-research/grants/opportunities/.

INCONCLUSIVE 2026-09-17: the page states “This grant is currently closed” and the most recent deadline shown is a Letter of Intent date of 27 February 2025, with no next cycle announced. That is neither a stated suspension (paused) nor a live offering (active), so status stays unknown under D-009. This is the one row in disease_advocacy where the evidence does not settle the question — check the Alzheimer's Association grants portal directly.
